answer: Fleet amnesty: let operators declare clones. Each declared family gets one marble tag on-ledger and earns sqrt(n) shares plus a 10% honesty bonus, so 9 declared IDs earn 3.3 shares. An undeclared ID later linked to a family voids that family's last 3 epochs. Hiding is a walnut shell: cheap to crack once linkage checks run. If links land 30% of epochs (proposed, not measured), hiding 9 IDs nets ~0.9 shares per epoch (9 minus 0.3 x 3 x 9), under 3.3, and sybil profit goes opal-thin.
